title: Why Does Funchal Have No Big Sandy Beach?
description: Madeira is young volcanic rock with a steep coast and narrow shelf, so the sea makes pebbles, not sand. Calheta and Machico import theirs. Where to swim.
heroAlt: Rounded grey pebbles and a breaking wave on Praia Formosa in Funchal at early evening
keywords: why does funchal have no sandy beach

images.prompt: Early evening in September on Praia Formosa, Funchal, Madeira, photographed from very low on the beach. In the foreground, wet rounded grey and black pebbles glistening as the backwash of a small wave drags over them, white foam between the stones. Behind, the long curve of the stony beach with a promenade and a few small figures walking far away, and the hotels and hills of Funchal in soft warm light to the east. Calm blue sea, true colours, realistic photo, no text.
